chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 515: Li Huowang Rejects Political Games in "One of Us"
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang arrives at a feast with the Emperor's strategists, only to find they are all talk. He gives a very bloody demonstration of what "working the job" really means.
og_title: One of Us – A Bloody Lesson in Court Politics
og_description: Li Huowang crashes a dinner party and proves that in the Dao-Twisted World, the knife always gets the final word.
twitter_title: Li Huowang crashes a dinner party (and a skull)
twitter_description: The "thinkers" are all talk until the sword arrives. Li Huowang's brutal new approach to politics is just terrifying.

lore_anchors.definition: An ancient Chinese political and philosophical school focused on forming alliances. In this novel, they are realistic strategists who manipulate state relations but are useless in a direct fight.
A decadent drinking practice where a courtesan holds wine in her mouth for a nobleman to drink directly, symbolizing the opulence and moral decay of the elite.
A long, single-edged Chinese saber with a curved blade, often used by cavalry. Its appearance here emphasizes the professionalism of the killers on the river.

A central philosophical dichotomy. The 'False' (修假) allows a Heart-Element to make hallucinations real, while the 'True' (修真) represents orthodox cultivation. Li Huowang's power is a corruption of the expected path.
